note: Impasse des Fourneaux place 1/4; landmark: giant wooden pepper-mill tower on the left and a clock tower at the far end of the snowy alley. Restyled from the live painting (same figures) to cartoony storybook 2.5, snowy winter alley with steaming chimneys, pale grey and green. Minor: the pirate's garlic bulb reaches ~5% from the top edge; the salt shaker prop runs to the left edge (box starts at 180). No -er/-ir markers, no painted text.
